Those given the Scripture and believers were instructed to fear Allah, who owns the heavens and earth, needs no one, can replace people, and holds the reward of both worlds.
Believers are told to fear Allah, seek the means of nearness to Him and strive in His cause so they may succeed.
If believers fear Allah, He will give them a criterion, remove their misdeeds and forgive them.
Believers are told to fear Allah and speak justly, so He will amend their deeds and forgive their sins, and obeying Allah and His Messenger is a great attainment.
Believers must fear Allah, look to what they send ahead for tomorrow and not be like those who forgot Allah; the people of the Fire and Paradise are not equal.
Those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward.
